subject: Parkside Health — hosted API rate request
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Parkside Health — hosted API pricing ask (escalation)

Ben / Lauren —

Quick summary: Parkside Health (enterprise health data SaaS) is asking for a one-time pricing concession on Hosted API usage to accelerate their product launch. They are proposing a 2-year commitment and want a 30% off list rate for the first 12 months across text-generation and embeddings. They claim a ramp to ~300M tokens/month within Q2 post-signing.

Why this matters:
- Strategic customer in large integrated health market (high reference value)
- They will move substantial volume; we can win additional partner integrations across their network
- They require HIPAA BA + standard Redwood Hosted API (no Dedicated)

Ask: I need exec approval to offer >20% concession. Finance/Deal Desk guidance so far: standard max concession without exec is 20%. I recommend we approve 25% for the first 12 months with a minimum committed spend clause and DocuSign MOU.

Attached: parkside_pricing_model.xlsx (forecast + unit economics).

Next steps I propose:
1) Exec approval (yes/no + any guardrails)
2) If approved, Legal to prepare amendment + BA agreement
3) Sales to get signed MOU and initial PO

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-09-06T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parkside Health — hosted API pricing ask (escalation)

Thanks Neha — good write-up. A few quick items we need before we pull an exec: 

- Confirmed 12-mo revenue run rate (ARR delta) and gross margin impact at 25% and 30% (use the attached sheet).
- Must include an explicit minimum committed token volume and monthly true-up clause. If they fail ramp, concession reverses.
- Do we have any technical blockers for HIPAA BA on Hosted API (we may need Private or Dedicated if they insist on certain enclave requirements).

My recommendation: push for 25% concession for year 1 with strict minimums and a 2-year term (year 2 at 15% off). That keeps us inside acceptable margin thresholds and is defensible if Lauren asks. If Neha can confirm the forecast and legalese, I'll route to Lauren for sign-off.

Ben Carter
VP, Global Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-09-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parkside Health — hosted API pricing ask (escalation) — Executive decision

Team —

After reviewing the model and commercial risk, I approve a 25% off list Hosted API concession for the first 12 months under the following conditions:

1) Minimum committed usage of 75M tokens/month in year 1 (true-up monthly; missed commitments result in retroactive price adjustment).
2) Two-year term: Year 1 at 25% off, Year 2 at 15% off (no further concessions without renewed exec approval).
3) HIPAA BA must be executed and Legal must sign off on SLA redlines before any PHI is transmitted.
4) Deal Desk to ensure minimum net margin threshold is maintained; Finance to confirm final numbers before DocuSign.
5) Approval limited to Hosted API (if technical or enclave requirements force a Private deployment, this concession is void).

Neha — please capture these terms in the MOU and loop Legal & Finance. Ben, help with margin verification and counterparty PO. Rishi, please ensure we have a legal redline process running and confirm SLA feasibility.

I'll sign an exec note and circulate.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: exec_approval_note.pdf
